questions.subject: Digital Electronics
questions.questionHtml:
A MOD 2 and a MOD 5 up-counter when cascaded together results in a MOD ______
counter. (in integer)
questions.existingSolutionSnippet:
Overall MOD = 2 x 5 = 10

Therefore, the correct answer is **10**.
